title: Localization equivalences and scalar compatibility
statement: Let A be a commutative local ring, C its maximal-ideal adic completion, U open in Spec A, q:Y → U, s:E → Spec C, E affine, and D the supplied overlap identification [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Let t ∈ ℕ and f:Fin t → A with D(f_i) contained in U and V_i=(q followed by U inclusion)⁻¹D(f_i) affine. Use the fixed completed and chart section modules [def-sbc-punctured-completion-chart-section-modules]. There exist A-linear alpha_i:(Γ(E,top))_(f_i) ≃ C tensor_A M_i. The alpha_i commute with the localized C-action. The maps are constructed from the affine localization, affine pullback, and D, rather than chosen as arbitrary witnesses.

source.place: Tag 0BLH, first two proof paragraphs; Tag 05EL, item (1).

proof.text: For each chart apply exists_completed_affine_section_localization to φ:A→C, E, s and f_i. It provides an A-linear equivalence e_i from localized completed global sections to sections on s⁻¹D(φ(f_i)), with the localized C-scalar compatibility.

Apply exists_chart_tensor_sections to D and the affine chart. It supplies a C-linear equivalence d_i from the scalar-extended chart module to the same completed-open sections. Restrict its scalars explicitly along φ and compose e_i with its inverse. The scalar equality follows by rewriting with the compatibility of e_i and applying the C-linearity of d_i inverse. Assemble the family; no new data definition is chosen from mere existence.

theorem exists_chart_completed_localizations_alpha
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens} {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme}
    {E : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine E] {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))}
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) (t : ℕ) (f : Fin t → A)
    (hf : ∀ i, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i) ≤ U)
    (hV : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen ((q ≫ U.ι) ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i))) :
    let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    let φ := algebraMap A C
    let M' := completedSectionModule s
    let M := fun i ↦ chartSectionModule (q ≫ U.ι) (f i)
    ∃ alpha : ∀ i, FormalGlueing.localize (f i) (FormalGlueing.restrict φ M') ≃ₗ[A]
      FormalGlueing.restrict φ (FormalGlueing.extend φ (FormalGlueing.piece (f i) (M i))),
      ∀ i (z : C) (x : FormalGlueing.localize (f i) (FormalGlueing.restrict φ M')),
        alpha i ((FormalGlueing.localizedSModule φ (f i) M').smul z x) =
          z • (alpha i x : FormalGlueing.extend φ (FormalGlueing.piece (f i) (M i)))
